items.html: It turns out that the past Malchut de Yetzira was the past Ever ha Yarden and the current Malchut de Beria was Behinat Suria. The last six of the past Assiya, which are the first six of the current Yetzira, were Hutz la Eretz since these were then Behinat Assiya. It is known that Assiya hangs in Hutz la Eretz and controls there, and we have already explained that the Raglaim of Adam ha Rishon were from Hutz la Eretz.
